queue.title: Automation Test Engineer (Remote)
queue.description: Tier One Technologies has an immediate need for a Test Automation Engineer to support our US Government client. This will be a 100% remote position. SELECTED CANDIDATES WITHOUT REQUIRED CLEARANCE WILL BE SUBJECT TO A FEDERAL GOVERNMENT BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION TO RECEIVE IT. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of complex applications and services. Define automation test strategy and plans for products, systems, components…
